# aaplimg.com
> Apple’s image and asset delivery domain used to host product imagery, media resources, and static web assets.

This domain primarily serves static images and media for Apple web properties rather than a conventional documentation site. Publicly useful context is best organized around major Apple web destinations and media resources that commonly reference assets delivered from aaplimg.com.

## Apple Product Pages
- [iPhone](https://www.apple.com/iphone/): Apple’s iPhone product hub with models, comparisons, and feature overviews.
- [Mac](https://www.apple.com/mac/): Apple’s Mac lineup overview including notebooks, desktops, and accessories.
- [iPad](https://www.apple.com/ipad/): Apple’s iPad family page with models, accessories, and buying guidance.
- [Apple Watch](https://www.apple.com/apple-watch/): Apple Watch product information, bands, features, and comparisons.
- [AirPods](https://www.apple.com/airpods/): AirPods lineup overview with features, compatibility, and purchasing options.
- [TV & Home](https://www.apple.com/tv-home/): Apple TV, HomePod, and smart home product information.

## Apple Support
- [Support Home](https://support.apple.com/): Main Apple Support portal for troubleshooting, repairs, and account help.
- [iPhone Support](https://support.apple.com/iphone): Support resources, setup help, and troubleshooting for iPhone.
- [Mac Support](https://support.apple.com/mac): Support articles, service options, and troubleshooting for Mac.
- [iPad Support](https://support.apple.com/ipad): Help content for setup, usage, and repair of iPad devices.
- [Apple Watch Support](https://support.apple.com/watch): Apple Watch setup, troubleshooting, and service documentation.
- [AirPods Support](https://support.apple.com/airpods): Support guidance for pairing, charging, and troubleshooting AirPods.

## Developer Resources
- [Apple Developer](https://developer.apple.com/): Central hub for Apple platform development resources, tools, and documentation.
- [Documentation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/): API documentation for Apple frameworks, languages, and platform technologies.
- [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/xcode/): Information about Apple’s IDE for building apps across platforms.
- [Swift](https://developer.apple.com/swift/): Swift language resources, downloads, and learning materials.
- [Design](https://developer.apple.com/design/): Human Interface Guidelines and design resources for Apple platforms.
- [Downloads](https://developer.apple.com/download/): Developer software downloads, betas, and supporting tools.

## Platform Documentation
- [iOS](https://developer.apple.com/ios/): Development resources and platform information for iPhone applications.
- [iPadOS](https://developer.apple.com/ipados/): Platform guidance and APIs for building iPad experiences.
- [macOS](https://developer.apple.com/macos/): Documentation and tools for developing applications on macOS.
- [watchOS](https://developer.apple.com/watchos/): Resources for building apps and experiences for Apple Watch.
- [tvOS](https://developer.apple.com/tvos/): Development guidance for Apple TV applications and media experiences.
- [visionOS](https://developer.apple.com/visionos/): Platform resources for spatial computing on Apple Vision Pro.

## Services and Ecosystem
- [Apple Music](https://www.apple.com/apple-music/): Music streaming service information, features, and subscription details.
- [Apple TV+](https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-plus/): Streaming service overview with original shows and subscription information.
- [iCloud](https://www.apple.com/icloud/): Cloud storage and synchronization service overview for Apple users.
- [Apple One](https://www.apple.com/apple-one/): Bundle page for combining Apple subscription services.
- [Apple Pay](https://www.apple.com/apple-pay/): Digital payments service overview, setup, and merchant information.
- [App Store](https://www.apple.com/app-store/): App distribution marketplace overview for Apple devices.

## Newsroom and Media
- [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/): Official Apple press releases, announcements, and company news.
- [Newsroom Archive](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/archive/): Archived Apple announcements and historical press materials.
- [Apple Leadership](https://www.apple.com/leadership/): Executive leadership profiles and organizational information.
- [Media Helpline](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/media-contacts/): Contact information for members of the press and media.
- [Apple Events](https://www.apple.com/apple-events/): Event announcements, videos, and presentation recaps.
- [Apple Podcasts Press](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/): Newsroom entry point for service and product press materials.

## Retail and Purchasing
- [Apple Store](https://www.apple.com/store): Online Apple Store for products, accessories, and services.
- [Shop iPhone](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-iphone): Purchase and configure iPhone models online.
- [Shop Mac](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac): Purchase Mac notebooks and desktops from Apple.
- [Shop iPad](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-ipad): Buy iPad models, accessories, and related services.
- [Shop Apple Watch](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-watch): Configure and purchase Apple Watch models and bands.
- [Refurbished](https://www.apple.com/shop/refurbished): Certified refurbished Apple products available through the online store.

## Accessibility and Environment
- [Accessibility](https://www.apple.com/accessibility/): Accessibility features and inclusive design across Apple products.
- [Environment](https://www.apple.com/environment/): Apple’s environmental initiatives, reports, and sustainability commitments.
- [Privacy](https://www.apple.com/privacy/): Privacy principles, controls, and product privacy information.
- [Education](https://www.apple.com/education/): Education-focused purchasing, programs, and institutional resources.
- [Business](https://www.apple.com/business/): Apple solutions, deployment, and support resources for businesses.
- [Government](https://www.apple.com/r/store/government/): Government purchasing and procurement information for eligible organizations.
